title: Chyba editoru při přeposílání (inline): Uzamčení dočasných souborů v Tempu při ukládání konceptu a odesílání
creator: fandovic
content:
Problém spočívá v kritickém selhání správy dočasných souborů a vnitřní mezipaměti (cache) v editoru zpráv Thunderbirdu. K chybám dochází na čistě lokální úrovni (účet ukládá koncepty i odeslanou poštu výhradně do Místních složek na disku) při operaci Přeposlat inline (v těle zprávy), pokud e-mail obsahuje přílohu (např. PDF, JPG). Editor zpráv nedokáže správně řídit životní cyklus dočasných souborů v systémovém adresáři Temp: po prvotní manipulaci korektně neuvolňuje souborové zámky v operačním systému Windows a při opakovaných pokusech o přístup agresivně spoléhá na neplatné cesty ve své interní paměti, namísto nového vybalení dat z originální zprávy. To vede k řetězovému selhání od uložení konceptu až po samotné odeslání. Detailní rozpis jednotlivých chyb: Chyba 1: Selhání uložení konceptu (Zámek souboru v adresáři Temp) Popis chování: Uživatel píše zprávu a stiskne poprvé Ctrl + S (nebo proběhne první automatické ukládání). Thunderbird vytvoří v systémovém Tempu dočasné soubory (nsmail-XX.pdf / nsemail-X.eml) a úspěšně zapíše koncept do Místních složek. Technická příčina: Editor Thunderbirdu po úspěšném zápisu neuzavře souborový proud (file stream) k těmto dočasným souborům a ponechá je uzamčené systémem Windows. Následek: Jakmile uživatel stiskne Ctrl + S podruhé (nebo po uplynutí časového intervalu zareaguje automatické ukládání), proces narazí na svůj vlastní zámek. Editor vyhodí trvalou chybovou hlášku o odepření přístupu k dočasnému souboru.

Chyba 2: Selhání při odesílání zprávy (Zablokování procesu odeslání) Popis chování: Uživatel se pokusí rozepsanou zprávu odeslat. Technická příčina: Při odesílání se paralelně spouští dva procesy: fyzické odeslání přes SMTP a zápis kopie do složky Odeslaná pošta. Oba tyto procesy potřebují přistoupit k témuž dočasnému souboru přílohy v adresáři Temp. Následek: Protože editor kvůli chybě č. 1 drží na dočasném souboru exkluzivní zámek z předchozího ukládání konceptu, proces odesílání selže. Thunderbird nedokáže dokončit kompletaci zprávy, odesílání zhavaruje, okno s hotovou zprávou zmizí a uživatel je nucen psát vše znovu.

Chyba 3: Mrtvá příloha v editoru (Agresivní cache neexistující cesty) Popis chování: Uživatel zvolí u e-mailu „Přeposlat inline“. V rozepsaném okně nelze přílohu vůbec otevřít, prohlížet ani s ní manipulovat. Technická příčina: K této chybě dochází, pokud uživatel s přílohou daného mailu v minulosti pracoval a mezitím došlo k promazání nebo vyčištění systémového adresáře Temp. Editor zpráv se při novém přeposlání nepokusí extrahovat přílohu z MIME struktur e-mailu čistě od začátku, ale prioritně se vnitřně odkazuje na starou, již neexistující cache cestu v Tempu. Následek: Příloha v editoru zůstane zcela nefunkční. Jediným řešením je okno editoru zavřít (čímž se vymaže vnitřní cache okna) a zvolit „Přeposlat“ znovu, což konečně vynutí čistou extrakci dat na disk.

title: Quick Filter does not return correct results in Unified Inbox
creator: vilro03
content:
Quick Filter does not return correct results in Unified Inbox (Thunderbird 140.12.0 ESR)

I'm using Thunderbird **140.12.0 ESR (aarch64)** and believe I've found an issue with the Quick Filter when searching the **Unified Inbox**.

    • Steps to reproduce:**

1. Open the **Unified Inbox**. 2. Open the Quick Filter bar. 3. Enter a search term (e.g. "maddy").

    • Observed behaviour in the Unified Inbox:**
  • With no "Filter messages by" options selected, entering a search term does not filter the message list.
  • Selecting **Sender**, **Recipients** and **Subject** still does not return the expected email.
  • Selecting **Body** changes the results after a delay, but the expected email is still **not** returned.

If I open the **actual Inbox** containing that same email and repeat the search:

  • The expected email is found using **Sender**, **Recipients** and **Subject**.
  • When **Body** is selected, the search takes longer and eventually returns additional matching messages, including the expected email.

This behaviour is reproducible with multiple search terms and suggests that the Quick Filter does not search the **Unified Inbox (virtual folder)** correctly, even though the same search works in the underlying physical folder.

Could you please confirm whether this is a known issue or a bug?

title: Forwarded attachments disappear after first IMAP draft save and subsequent saves fail with NS_ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND
creator: opilny
content:
Thunderbird 152.0.1 (64-bit) Build ID: 20260630165458 Windows 11 IMAP account hosted by Wedos

I found what appears to be a reproducible bug when forwarding messages with attachments.

Steps to reproduce:

1. Open an email with a JPG attachment. 2. Click Forward. 3. Save the message as Draft (IMAP Drafts). 4. Without closing the compose window, save the draft again.

Result:

The second save always fails with:

"An error occurred attaching 20260520_123800.jpg. Please check whether you have access to the file."

Error Console shows:

Failed to fetch attachment NS_ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND url=file:///C:/Users/<user>/AppData/Local/Temp/nsmail-1.jpg

I also observed that after the first draft save Thunderbird deletes:

C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\Temp\nsmail-1.jpg

However, the compose window still references this deleted temporary file.

Additional observations:

- Creating a new message and attaching a file from disk works correctly. - Forwarding a message without attachments works correctly. - Removing the forwarded attachment and attaching the same file from disk also works correctly. - Closing and reopening the saved draft restores normal behavior.

This appears to be a bug where the compose window continues using a deleted temporary attachment instead of the attachment stored in the IMAP draft.

Can anyone reproduce this with Thunderbird 152.0.1?

title: Continue to have "Authentication Required" POPup errors at startup.
creator: dcpdjp
content:
After reinstalling a Windstream.net email account I continue to have Authentication Required errors at startup. Popup messages only occurs during thunderbird startup. And Only on my Windstream.net email accounts. not my outlook.com and Gmail accounts.

the following is the popup window during Thunderbird startup.

"Authentication Required - Mozila Thunderbird https://imap.windstream.net is requesting your username and password."

I entered the username and password and check the save box. The popup returns with the same error asking for the same info. If I just select CANCEL, it pops up 2 more times and after the third cancel, the popup shows no more. The account fills with any incoming emails from Windstream.net. The Windstream.net account seams to work normal from that point on. I Can send and receive fine with no more popups. Until I restart thunderbird then this error starts all over. Is this a thunderbird or Windstream.net issue? Any suggestions on a fix? Also I have a gmail and outlook.com account with no issues.

title: Opening new messages has changed from "one click" to "double click" operation.
creator: a.tierney
content:
I'm running Thunderbird Ver 152.0.1 with Windows 11. I have things set up so that I just need a single click to open a program, folder or file.

This also was the case until just recently with Thunderbird. I could open new messages with just a single click. For some reason this has changed to me needing to double click to open new messages.

I don't know why and cannot find any method of changing the software back to single click operation. It is only affecting Thunderbird all the Windows operations still operate with one click.

Can you advise me on how to reset the Thunderbird software to single click operation.

Many thanks. Alan Tierney

title: Have difficulty deleting emails
creator: Davekubs
content:
I recently bought a new HP laptop running Windows 11, and installed Thunderbird I am still using an older HP laptop running Windows 10, running Thunderbird for years without issues

I installed Thunderbird on the new Windows 11 laptop (without using the USB drive for the profile) and managed to carry over the address book using my account from the old laptop. It is working, but acts odd when deleting emails.

When I delete an email (by highlighting it and hit Delete) in the Inbox, it disappears from the Inbox, but it still shows up in the All Mail folder. When I try to delete it from the All Mail folder (by highlighting it and hit Delete), it disappears for a split second and then comes back. The only way to permanently delete ANY email is to move it to the Local Folders - Trash.

It's like playing whack a mole!

I'm wondering if there is some setting issue, or if I should just uninstall Thunderbird, reinstall it again using the USB for the profile from the old laptop and start all over.

I would appreciate any help!

title: Probleme bei Umstellung von POP auf IMAP
creator: rudolf.weinzierl-landshut
content:
Subject: Thunderbird 152 – IMAP Junk messages are not automatically moved to Spam (T-Online IMAP) I am using Thunderbird 152 on Windows 11 with a Deutsche Telekom (T-Online) IMAP account. Problem When I manually mark a message as Junk (toolbar button, context menu or Junk column), the message briefly disappears from the Inbox and immediately reappears. It is marked as Junk, but it is not moved to the Spam folder. If I disable the option "Move new junk messages to:", the message remains in the Inbox and is marked as Junk, without the brief disappearance. Manual Move to → Spam always works correctly. Environment • Windows 11 • Thunderbird 152 • T-Online IMAP • ESET Internet Security • Only one Spam folder exists on the T-Online server. Troubleshooting already performed • Created a completely new IMAP account. • Verified Junk settings. • Verified the Spam folder path: imap://...@secureimap.t-online.de/Spam • Manual move to Spam works correctly. • Rebuilt the folder cache. • Recreated folderTree/folder cache files. • Performed IMAP resynchronization. • Tested with ESET mail protection enabled and disabled (no change). • Checked profile configuration. • Verified that the IMAP server directory setting does not change the behaviour. Additional observation The profile contains two IMAP cache directories: • secureimap.t-online.de • secureimap.t-online-1.de The current IMAP directory does not contain local Spam/Junk cache files, while the old "-1" directory still contains: • Spam • Spam.msf • Junk • Junk.msf Thunderbird also displays a greyed-out, inaccessible Spam/Junk folder which cannot be selected, subscribed or removed. Question Is this a known issue in Thunderbird 152 related to IMAP Junk handling or old IMAP cache migration after changing an account from POP to IMAP? If not, which log or additional information would help identify the cause?

PS: The POP account worked correctly before the migration to IMAP. The problem started only after switching from POP to IMAP. Rudolf.weinzierl-landshut@t-online.de

title: Thunderbird all'avvio apre pagine del browser
creator: gemma.mar
content:
Buonasera, ho un problema con un account aziendale di office, praticamente senza volerlo ho creato un account uguale ma con un profilo diverso e Thunderbird continua a cercare di fare il login su live.com di quello sbagliato (anche se lo ho cancellato)

Per risolvere questo problema ho provato a dare istruzioni a Thunderbird di cercare di fare il login tramite Safari (Browser di default) e devo aver combinato un grosso casino perchè ora ogni volta che avvio Thunderbird cerca di aprire pagine di safati (https://incoming-telemetry.thunderbird.net/submit/telemetry/a57c7260-b90b-485b-b370-63f2bd8e9741/main/Thunderbird/152.0.1/release/20260630165458?v=4) che chiede di essere autorizzato a farlo ma comunque non lo fa. Ogni volta (pochi minuti) che Thunderbird cerca nuove mail fa lo stesso, apre una decina di pagine vuote e cerca di scaricare dei file Ho provato a reinstallare Thunderbird e ad installare Firefox ma succede la stessa cosa (tranne che fra le pagine vuote si apre anche https://notifications.thunderbird.net/2.0/notifications.json) Ho provato a cancellare (seguendo istruzioni) un file handler,json ma niente!

Grazie per il vostro auto
